title: Vacuum stress depends on the local temporal dilation factor

statements.text: The local vacuum stress depends on the temporal dilation factor $\gamma_t$ of the conservation structure, so a controlled change in the temporal state of a bounded system shifts the Casimir force by a small fraction, with no new geometric scale.

sources.quote: Within the Chronoflux formulation, the local vacuum stress depends on the temporal dilation factor that enters the covariant conservation structure of the theory.
